About re:medi

About

Remedi considers the balance of the face and body together. First-time visitors can find clear information about our practitioner, location, appointments, evening hours, consultations with the director and in-house herbal preparation.

re:medi Korean Medicine Clinic is also known by the nickname “곰추한의원”.

Medical Director

Clinic Director Eun-bin Hong

During your consultation, the director personally reviews your concerns and care options, explaining facial asymmetry, skeletal alignment, pain and weight-management care in light of your individual condition.

Facial Asymmetry Clinic

Facial asymmetry care

When assessing differences between the two sides of the face, we consider eye level, the tip of the nose, the corners of the mouth and the jawline alongside the jaw joints, neck and shoulder tension, and posture habits.

Facial asymmetry: causes, symptoms & care

Eye level Tip of the nose Corners of the mouth Jawline
Face Balance Index

We consider both differences visible in photographs and those that appear during movement.

01Left and right facial contours

We first check the reference lines of the eyes, nose, mouth and chin.

02Jaw movement

We assess the movement path and tension when you open and close your mouth.

03Daily habits

We also review chewing habits, sleeping position and posture when using a smartphone.

Skeleton & Posture

Focused skeletal alignment & posture care

We consider recurring posture concerns such as #ForwardHeadPosture, #FlatBack and #HipMisalignment in relation to facial contours, pain and changes in body shape.

01

Forward head posture

We assess how tension around the neck and jaw affects facial contours and shoulder pain.

02

Flat back

We assess back movement and tension around the rib cage, considering breathing and postural balance together.

03

Hip misalignment

We consider left-to-right differences in the pelvis and hips in relation to walking, lower-back tension and changes in body shape.

Simple Diet

Simple Diet

From localized fat treatments and body lifting to consultations about remote care, we suggest a simple, sustainable approach based on your areas of concern and daily routine.

01

Localized fat treatments

02

Body lifting

03

Remote consultations

04

Lifting & contour care

Bride Balance

Bridal care

Ahead of scheduled events such as wedding photography, the ceremony and dress fittings, we address facial contours, puffiness, and upper-arm, thigh and abdominal contours together.

  1. 01Review your schedule

    We set consultation priorities around your photo shoot and wedding dates.

  2. 02Facial balance

    We first review concerns about facial asymmetry, puffiness and the jawline.

  3. 03Body contours

    We discuss concerns about the upper arms, thighs and abdomen in relation to your dress silhouette.

  4. 04Maintain your well-being

    We also work on sleep, digestion and stress patterns.

Pain & Traffic Accident

Care after traffic accidents

We assess acute and chronic pain, symptoms after traffic accidents, and tension or discomfort in the neck, lower back and shoulders in light of your current condition and the course since the accident.

01

Symptoms after traffic accidents

We assess lingering discomfort in the neck, lower back and shoulders after an accident.

02

Acute & chronic pain

We review where recurring pain occurs, how long it lasts and what makes it worse.

03

Recovery routine

We explain a follow-up visit plan to connect clinical care with daily self-care.

In-house Decoction

Your Korean medicine doctor prepares your herbal decoction in-house

Consultation, prescribing and herbal preparation take place in one location so that each patient's condition can be reflected more carefully.
